title: Introduction to Computer Applications: Supplementary Exam, August 2018
instructions: (i) Answer question ONE and any other TWO questions (ii) Do not write on this question paper (iii) Switch off your cell phone(s)

items.text: (Total 30 Marks) (i) Describe the information and communication technology (ICT) infrastructure that you may have seen being used by tellers in a computerized supermarket and how it is used. (ii) Supposing you were assigned to work in a modern radio station, what kind of computer input devices and output devices would you expect to find there? (iii) If you intend to buy a computer, explain how you would decide which computer system to be purchased, what software to install inside it and what peripheral devices it should have? (iv) Explain the importance of system software to a computer system. (v) Explain what you understand by the term application software. (vi) Explain the steps you would take to do the following using the Windows operating system:

parts.text: Open a document that was used recently
Delete a file or folder permanently
Search for a file or folder saved on the computer
